en: Colorized illustration of several traditional sailboats with large triangular sails (likely feluccas) on a wide river at sunset or sunrise. Low riverbanks with greenery and distant buildings appear on the right horizon. The style is typical of early 20th‑century tourist postcards. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the scene as a Nile boat in Cairo and includes a small serial number and publisher mark.
